top.context: The Indian financial landscape is governed by the RBI (monetary policy/interest rates) and SEBI (market regulations/settlement cycles), both of which frequently update frameworks to manage inflation and market efficiency.
top.why: Changes in repo rates directly impact borrowing costs for corporations and consumer spending, while new SEBI settlement frameworks can alter liquidity dynamics and operational costs for brokers and investors.
top.watch: Monitor the specific implementation timelines for these new rules to gauge their immediate impact on market liquidity and corporate margins.

top.watch: Daily FII and DII trading activity data to see if foreign buying momentum persists.
